scope: Exploratory H2 only; no formal thesis threshold and no claim of obstacle resolution

V0.role: seen matched background; existing qualified sources may be reused

geometry.p_M_basis: Transparent round interior coordinate on existing lane; creates over1km observable travel without geometric change. No evidence that100m is optimal.
geometry.alternative_policy: Choose at B only if physical review rejects100m; not an authorized parameter sweep or post-result retry.
geometry.V1_feeder_role: Qualification and descriptive formation domain; no V0 upstream causal comparison because V0 lacks this traveled segment.
geometry.common_domain_role: M-only FCD trajectories traversing identical spatial interval in both versions; old downstream E1 at100m mixes M/R and is not this cohort.
geometry.section_method: FCD last-below/first-at-or-above crossing brackets; no new E1 or netconvert required for this measurement proposal.
geometry.coverage_tolerance_basis: Proposed two output-position hundredths; not traffic-state threshold. Engineer must confirm decimal output precision before registration.
geometry.spatial_sensitivity: Report the full existing lane-class grid and domain boundary brackets; any alternate numeric common domain must be pre-registered before new outcomes. No post-result spatial optimization.

reference.qualification: lower-load empirical comparator, not established free-flow/capacity reference
reference.basis: Seen12-run inventory:1083 M vehicles per ML run; A-window R passage67/69; same qRamp as challenge.

challenge.basis: Higher mainline load than ML with36/40 seen A-window R passages. Prefer bounded joint-observation opportunity over MH/3650 with zero A passage. No promised positive M impairment.

conditions.fixed_U_X: Copy exact archived generator and counts; do not infer continuous input rate from delayed entry. Actual fields must be copied into final card from original demand XML.

alternatives_not_selected.QM3650_and_MH: A-window R0/0; unsuitable default joint-window challenge
alternatives_not_selected.RL: Changes qRamp relative to ML and confounds intended single demand-axis comparison

matrix.V0_information: seen_reused; reuse4 existing runs only if new common-domain source/definition/qualification receipts match
matrix.V1_information: new_condition_or_seed: new insertion configuration plus previously unavailable upstream traveled observation; old seeds are not newly independent random draws
matrix.new_information_limit: Inference conditional on these two chosen seeds and seen demand conditions; no generalization or statistical power claim.
matrix.alternative_new_seed_matrix: If reviewer requires unselected stochastic replication, replace the whole proposed seed set before registration and run all8 logical cells; exact new seeds unknown_requires_registration. Do not append seeds after seeing outcomes.

time_contract.warmup_qualification: B is a historical analysis cut, not proven stationary warm-up.
time_contract.basis: Keep identical finite observation horizon for eligible oldV0 reuse. Historical latest arrival2558 leaves142s; 1294.87/33.33=38.849985s is merely nominal no-delay travel, not a clearance guarantee.
time_contract.censor_rule: Never extend after an unfavorable result; record entered/arrived/outside at1500/2700 and incomplete crossings. Required scientific cohort with unresolvable truncation cannot pass.
time_contract.Post_role: May contain delayed R/U entries; do not call it recovery without checking actual zero inflow.
time_contract.time_sensitivity: A,Post,Full descriptive; primary gate remainsB.60s bins, sensitivity30/120s may be computed only as registered robustness diagnostics, never substituted to rescue primary failure.

entry_and_reference_qualification.identity_and_hash_requirement: 100% required files, IDs, registered lanes and time labels; no unexplained duplicate/missing/nonfinite critical values
entry_and_reference_qualification.V1_rule: Every entered M must have registered actual departPos and bracketed passage200 then1200 then common100 then700, or an explicit incomplete/censored state; no removal of delayed or blocked vehicles.100% is coverage target, not forced completion assumption.
entry_and_reference_qualification.sample_basis: Exploratory administrative adequacy proposals; seen ML B completed866/868. Neither500 nor20 is a power calculation.
entry_and_reference_qualification.reference_stability_rule: unknown_requires_registration: define allowable within-window trend/dispersion and handling of transient bins; lower requested demand alone does not qualify reference.
entry_and_reference_qualification.realized_inflow_rule: unknown_requires_registration: compare M requested/entered, departDelay, arrival at feeder/merge sections and lane allocation. Reviewer must decide tolerance and whether mismatch changes estimand; never silently attribute insertion-induced inflow loss solely to distance.

scientific_rule_candidates.registration_state: unknown_requires_registration; numbers below are explicit discussion proposals, not frozen success rules

M_primary.metric: mean M common-domain travel time for bracket-qualified common-entry cohort inB
M_primary.estimate: mean lower/upper bounds separately; retain boundary-ambiguous and incomplete denominator
M_primary.conservative_candidate_test: challenge mean lower bound >1.10*same-version same-seed reference mean upper bound
M_primary.basis: Exploratory meaningful-effect proposal; no formal traffic standard; old 1Hz trajectories produce2s individual TT bound width, which must not be ignored.

M_support.metric: M-only common-domain vehicle-time-weighted speed plus accumulation and technical stopping
M_support.candidate_test: speed ratio <=0.95 in3 consecutive eligible matched60s bins; show accumulation, completed flow and stopping in the same intervals
M_support.limit: Travel time and speed share trajectories and are correlated; accumulation rises with demand and is not automatically a bottleneck proof. Technical stop0.1m/s remains descriptive.

R_support.metric: first main_down passage count and eligible R cohort/unfinished counts during registered support intervals
R_support.basis: Explicit exploratory event-support choice, not validated sufficient capacity. Reviewer must resolve actual intended-use adequacy beforeB passes.
R_support.boundary_rule: Crossing interval straddling a boundary remains ambiguous, not forced into a bin; show lower/upper count.

Q4_relation.candidate_rule: Required M support and R passage evidence share at least3 registered60s bins withinB in eachV1 seed; no post hoc adjacent-lag rescue
Q4_relation.causal_limit: Finite joint observability for uncontrolled suitability only; does not establish control benefit, sweet spot or pure urban loss.

scientific_rule_candidates.U_context: Report R upstream stop propagation, R/U shared stopped labels, U counts/time loss, movement-specific TLS and cross-window entering; no invented causal-U-loss threshold.

result_classes.technical_success: All source/runtime/output/coverage checks meet their registered contract; separate from scientific success.
result_classes.scientific_support: Both requiredV1 seeds meet the registered reference, primary, corroborating,R andQ4 rules with independent receipts; only bounded suitability support, still subject toSG6-R.
result_classes.not_resolved: Complete qualified evidence but either seed fails/contradicts required criteria, insufficient phenomenon/event support, reference not scientifically suitable, or primary sensitivity is not robust; no phenotype-driven retry.
result_classes.blocked_by_evidence_error: Source/hash/ID/time-grid/critical field/parser or reconstruction disagreement prevents interpretation. Preserve attempt; technical_failed execution is separately recorded, not coded as scientific negative.

budgets_advice.basis: Engineering management estimates; include failed/reserved attempts. Reused archives are separately retained; netconvert exact requirement is engineeringpending_C, not inferred approved.

unresolved_before_B_completion: all U/X demand fields copied from actual source
decision_owner: primary agent reconciles scientific_reviewer and simulation_engineer, then obtains required approval; data analyst does not freeze research settings
stop_boundary: Any required scientific unknown remains =>B incomplete; no implementation eligibility or simulator start inferred from this proposal
